projects.name: Resume Screening Assistant
projects.description: Intelligent Resume Analysis – Uses Generative AI to read, summarize, and extract key skills, experiences, and achievements from resumes, matching them against job requirements. Smart Candidate Shortlisting – Automatically categorizes and ranks candidates by relevance, while reducing bias and adapting with recruiter feedback.

projects.name: Soft Computing Project
projects.description: Fuzzy Logic Navigation – Designed a drone navigation system that makes real-time flight decisions using fuzzy rules. Genetic Algorithm Optimization – Enhanced path efficiency and obstacle avoidance by evolving the fuzzy control parameters.

projects.name: IOT Project
projects.description: Drowsiness Detection System Designed smart glasses with IR sensors using Arduino Nano. Triggered alerts using a buzzer and relay when prolonged eye closure detected.
